name: litehtml0.9
reason: Real library — "Fast and lightweight HTML/CSS rendering engine", embedded in other apps, not launchable on its own. No safe general pattern (versioned-library names like this collide with real apps that also carry a bare version number, e.g. 0ad/7zip/openttd).

name: profile-sync-daemon-zen
reason: Real support package — "Zen browser support for profile-sync-daemon", a companion file for a different tool (profile-sync-daemon), not launchable on its own.

name: cs-signal
reason: Real library — "Library for thread aware signal/slot delivery" (CopperSpice's signal/slot mechanism). No safe general pattern: "signal" as a keyword would also match real apps like signal-desktop.

name: claude-cowork-rs
reason: Real support package — "Linux daemon for Claude Desktop Cowork (Local Agent Mode)", a background helper process for a different app (Claude Desktop), not launchable on its own. No name-pattern would catch this (the word "daemon" is only in the description, not the name).

name: biosig4c++
reason: Real library — "A software library for processing of biomedical signals", hasDesktopFile:false. No safe general pattern: a bare "c++" substring check has real counter-examples (Gentoo's c++robots, a real King-of-the-Hill programming game).

name: python-adblock
reason: Real library — "Brave's adblock library in Python" (Python bindings for Brave's Rust adblock-parsing engine, published on PyPI as "adblock"), not the browser and not an extension. No safe general pattern: bare python-prefix names mix too many real CLI tools to blanket-exclude.

reason: Same real library as pacman-arch:python-adblock, Alpine's py3- naming. See that entry's reason.

name: adblock
reason: Same real library as pacman-arch:python-adblock, Gentoo's dev-python category. Category itself isn't safe to exclude wholesale either — verified live it mixes in real CLI tools (black, bpython, ipython, poetry).

reason: Same real library as pacman-arch:python-adblock, Void's python3- naming. See that entry's reason.
